Author-guide conflict exists: Success Criteria required in docs but inert in tests, and rejected-alternative requirement contradicts G6 authoritatively-stated positive-rationale-only rule (bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 filed).
Scoring should derive compatibility from satisfied/applicable checks rather than adding points to current scale, since filler compensation masks missing required sections.
